name: Ella Rock
description: A moderately challenging half-day trek that takes you past active railway tracks, through local farmlands, and up a steep eucalyptus forest to a high cliff edge overlooking the famous Ella Gap.

name: Adam's Peak (Sri Pada)
description: A deeply spiritual mountain climbed overnight via 5,200 continuous stone steps. Hikers reach the summit by dawn to witness a sacred footprint shrine and a perfectly triangular shadow cast by the rising sun.

name: Pidurangala Rock
description: A short, steep 30-minute scramble over giant boulders that places you directly opposite the famous Sigiriya Lion Rock fortress, making it the premier spot for sunrise and sunset photography.

name: Little Adam's Peak
description: A gentle, highly accessible 45-minute walk winding through lush green tea estates, ending with a short stair climb to a sharp ridge line that offers stunning 360-degree valley views.

name: World's End
description: A relatively flat 9.5-kilometer nature loop through high-altitude cloud forests and grasslands that leads to a sheer, dramatic cliff drop of nearly 900 meters inside Horton Plains National Park.

name: Kirigalpoththa
description: Sri Lanka’s second-highest peak, accessible via a rugged, often boggy 14-kilometer return trail that tests endurance with overgrown brush, muddy terrain, and steep rock slabs.

name: Thotupola Kanda
description: The island's third-highest peak, offering a much easier and shorter trail than Kirigalpoththa. It provides a quick route to experience high-altitude vegetation and panoramic views.

name: Knuckles Five Peaks
description: A grueling, full-day ridge-line trek across the five prominent peaks of the mist-shrouded Knuckles wilderness, requiring a local guide to navigate the dense, cloud-forest terrain.

name: Kabaragala Peak
description: The highest point in the Dolosbage range, featuring a massive, flat-topped summit with a sheer vertical drop that rivals World's End but sees far fewer tourists.

name: Narangala Mountain
description: A distinct, rectangular peak widely celebrated by local outdoor enthusiasts for its expansive golden grass meadows, heavy morning mist, and ideal overnight camping ridges.

name: Hanthana Mountain Range
description: A scenic ridge walk comprising seven individual peaks located just outside Kandy, offering hikers a versatile mix of gentle tea paths, craggy peaks, and city views.

name: Peacock Hill / Monara Gala
description: A quick and rewarding 30-minute hike through a pine forest that leads to a panoramic vantage point overlooking the Kotmale reservoir and the surrounding valleys.

name: Bible Rock / Bathalegala
description: A prominent, isolated mountain that resembles an open book from a distance. The trail is short but features a steady incline, leading to a wide, flat summit with views of the lowlands.

name: Riverston & Pitawala Patana
description: Located in the northern Knuckles region, this area features a windy trek up to a radio tower and a walk across a vast, sloping rock slab that abruptly ends at a precipitous drop known as 'Mini World's End'.

name: The Pekoe Trail
description: A newly developed, world-class walking trail covering over 300 kilometers and 22 distinct stages. It connects remote mountain towns, allowing hikers to walk directly through working tea communities, pine forests, and historic villages.

name: Lipton’s Seat
description: A long, scenic uphill walk through the endless green carpets of the Dambatenne tea estate, terminating at the exact lookout point where tea magnate Sir Thomas Lipton surveyed his fields.

name: Idalgashinna to Haputale Railway Walk
description: A unique, flat walking route along historic colonial-era train tracks that cuts through mountain tunnels, misty gaps, and pine forests, offering sweeping views on both sides of the ridge.

name: Sigiriya (Lion Rock)
description: An iconic ancient rock fortress and UNESCO World Heritage site rising nearly 200 meters above the jungle, featuring ancient frescoes, water gardens, and ruins of a royal palace at the summit.

name: Athugala (Elephant Rock)
description: A massive elephant-shaped dark rock overlooking Kurunegala city. It features a prominent 88-foot white Buddha statue at its summit, accessible via a paved scenic road or rocky steps.

name: Yapahuwa Rock Fortress
description: A massive granite rock rising 90 meters above the plains, famous for its magnificent, steep ornamental stone staircase and the ancient ruins of a 13th-century Sri Lankan capital.

name: Wangedigala
description: A highly popular camping and hiking destination in the Bambarakanda area, known for its steep pine forest trails and stunning, breezy views of the surrounding valleys and waterfalls.

name: Namunukula
description: Meaning 'Nine Peaks', this mountain range offers a challenging trek through tea estates and dense forests, rewarding hikers with spectacular sunrise views spanning across the Uva province.

name: Alagalla Mountain (Potato Mountain)
description: A historically significant peak offering a challenging rock scramble near the summit, rewarding adventurous hikers with stunning panoramic views of the central highlands.

name: Rose Quartz Mountain (Jathika Namal Uyana)
description: South Asia's largest pink quartz mountain range, situated within a beautiful, ancient ironwood forest. It offers a relatively easy climb with completely unique geological scenery.
